get.description: Checks on-demand service availability in Shipday.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: pickupAddress
parameters.description: Pickup address used for on-demand availability lookup.

schema.description: Pickup address used for on-demand availability lookup.
schema.example: 1 Wall St, New York, NY 10005, USA

parameters.name: deliveryAddress
parameters.description: Delivery address used for on-demand availability lookup.

schema.description: Delivery address used for on-demand availability lookup.

parameters.name: deliveryTime
parameters.description: Requested delivery timestamp for the availability check.

schema.description: Requested delivery timestamp for the availability check.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

error.description: Whether the provider returned an error.

id.description: Provider identifier for the availability row.

isInternal.description: Whether the provider route is internal.

isProd.description: Whether the quote came from a production provider configuration.

probableAssignment.description: Whether the provider indicates likely assignment.
